description:
WHAT: Chat-specific SSE event parsing on top of jmap-base-client SSE layer (after GAP-02 adds raw data field to SseEvent::Unknown).

ALGORITHM:
1. Create crate-jmap-chat-client/src/sse.rs
2. Define ChatSseEvent enum:
   pub enum ChatSseEvent {
     StateChange(jmap_base_client::push::StateChange),
     Typing { chat_id: Id, sender_id: Id, typing: bool },
     Presence { contact_id: Id, presence: jmap_chat_types::Presence, last_active_at: Option<String>, status_text: Option<String>, status_emoji: Option<String> },
     Unknown { event_type: String },
   }
3. Define ChatSseFrame { pub event: ChatSseEvent, pub id: Option<String> }
4. Define fn parse_chat_sse_block(block: &str) -> ChatSseFrame:
   - Call jmap_base_client::parse_sse_block(block) to get SseFrame
   - Match on SseFrame.event:
     * StateChange(sc) → ChatSseEvent::StateChange(sc)
     * Unknown { event_type, data } where event_type == "typing" → parse data as JSON for Typing
     * Unknown { event_type, data } where event_type == "presence" → parse data as JSON for Presence
     * Unknown { event_type, .. } → ChatSseEvent::Unknown { event_type }
   - Return ChatSseFrame { event, id: frame.id }
5. Declare in lib.rs: pub mod sse; pub use sse::{ChatSseEvent, ChatSseFrame, parse_chat_sse_block};

Source: ~/PROJECT/crate-jmapchat-client/src/sse.rs — port the Typing and Presence parsing logic.

DEFENSIVE RULES:
- On JSON parse failure for Typing/Presence data: return Unknown (never panic)
- Presence enum maps: 'online' → Online, 'away' → Away, etc. Unknown presence string → Unknown variant

TESTS (oracles from spec):
- parse_state_change_block: valid state change SSE → ChatSseEvent::StateChange with correct changed map
- parse_typing_block: typing event with chatId/senderId/typing → ChatSseEvent::Typing
- parse_presence_block: presence event → ChatSseEvent::Presence
- parse_unknown_block: 'event: newtype' → ChatSseEvent::Unknown
- parse_typing_malformed: bad JSON in data → ChatSseEvent::Unknown (no panic)
- parse_frame_id: SSE id: line preserved in ChatSseFrame.id

ACCEPTANCE: 6 named tests pass; cargo test -p jmap-chat-client passes; clippy clean
title: jmap-chat-client: sse.rs — ChatSseEvent enum and parse wrapper
